title: Grapeseed Crusted Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad recipe featuring a crispy grapeseed crusted chicken breast served on top of a bed of fresh greens. The zesty dressing and garlic flavor add a delightful twist to this classic dish.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together grapeseed oil and garlic powder.
Dip each chicken breast in the grapeseed mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 20-22 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the salad by combining mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber slices, and croutons in a large bowl.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Drizzle zesty vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
Slice the cooked chicken breast and place on top of the salad.
